questions.question: What does Zechariah 10 condemn the people for relying on?
options: The priests who had served faithfully at the holy altar
The prophets who had spoken the truth to the people
Household idols (teraphim) and diviners who speak lies
The kings of all of the surrounding hostile nations
questions.answer: Household idols (teraphim) and diviners who speak lies

questions.question: How does Zechariah 10 picture God's care for Judah?
options: As a king far off who has wholly forgotten his people in exile
As caring for his flock, making them like a majestic warhorse
As a stranger who passes by and shows them no concern
As a stern judge who weighs each of their deeds alone
questions.answer: As caring for his flock, making them like a majestic warhorse
